# pai handoff

Carry a session's work to a new one

```
pai handoff <command>
```

Exports a session transcript as a short, redacted Markdown brief (requests, files changed, recent commands, where it stopped) and prints the line to continue with. The brief never goes on the command line — only its path does. A `[pai-handoff from=<id>]` marker in the next session's first prompt is recorded in the handoff link log.

```sh
pai handoff export
pai handoff export 2026-10-22-session-id
pai handoff show ~/.pai/handoffs/abc-20261022-1430.md
```

See also: `pai audit tokens session`

### pai handoff export

Write the brief for a session (default: newest here)

```
pai handoff export [SESSION]
```

Prints the brief's path and the one-line continue hint. Secrets in the transcript are replaced with [REDACTED]; the brief is bounded to 48 KB.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SESSION` | no | Session id or transcript path (default: newest transcript of the current directory) |

```sh
pai handoff export
pai handoff export 2026-10-22-session-id
```

### pai handoff show

Print a handoff brief

```
pai handoff show PATH
```

Prints a brief written by `pai handoff export`.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PATH` | yes | Brief file |

```sh
pai handoff show ~/.pai/handoffs/abc-20261022-1430.md
```

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `pai handoff export` | Write the brief for a session (default: newest here) |
| `pai handoff show` | Print a handoff brief |
